cards.card_text: Hiram sends a reply: he'll do all Solomon desires about the cedar and cypress timber.
cards.verse_text: Then Hiram sent a reply to Solomon, saying: “I have received your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.
cards.snippet: …your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.

cards.card_text: So Hiram provides all the cedar and cypress Solomon wants, and Solomon sends Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, plus 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
cards.verse_text: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted, and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
cards.snippet: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted, and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with…

cards.card_text: Now he has something for Hiram king of Tyre, the man who supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.
cards.verse_text: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon built these two houses, the house of the LORD and the royal palace, King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.
cards.snippet: …to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.

cards.card_text: Next on the order: cedar, cypress and algum logs from Lebanon, since Hiram's servants know how to cut timber there.
cards.verse_text: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there.
cards.snippet: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have…

cards.card_text: Birds build their nests in those cedars, and the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
cards.verse_text: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
cards.snippet: …the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.

cards.card_text: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over the fallen king, and they've got something to say.
cards.verse_text: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over you: “Since you have been laid low, no woodcutter comes against us.”

cards.card_text: Why are the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon so glad the king of Babylon has been laid low?
cards.verse_text: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over you: “Since you have been laid low, no woodcutter comes against us.”

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He will plant cedars, acacias, myrtles and olive trees in the wilderness, and set cypresses, elms and boxwood together in the desert.
cards.verse_text: I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,
cards.snippet: I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,

cards.card_text: He cuts down cedars or gets a cypress or oak, and lets it grow strong among the trees.
cards.verse_text: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak.
cards.snippet: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up.
cards.verse_text: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up; this will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”
cards.snippet: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up;…

cards.card_text: Next, the glory of Lebanon, a land known for its forests, will come to Zion: its cypress, elm and boxwood together.
cards.verse_text: The glory of Lebanon will come to you—its cypress, elm, and boxwood together—to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
cards.snippet: The glory of Lebanon will come to you—its cypress, elm, and boxwood together—to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I…

cards.card_text: All the planking is cypress from Senir, and they take a cedar from Lebanon to make the mast.
cards.verse_text: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir.
cards.snippet: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He is like a flourishing cypress.
cards.verse_text: I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
cards.snippet: I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.

cards.card_text: With Lebanon's great cedar fallen, the cypress is told to ___.
cards.verse_text: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined!
cards.snippet: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined!
